value.name: urge revealing mother's truth
value.description: A speaker urges Lucia to reveal the truth at the right moment and not let Daniel's manipulation silence their mother's voice.
evidence: the truth is a powerful shield; we must reveal it at the right moment, but we cannot let fear of Daniel's manipulation silence our mother's voice.
We owe it to her legacy to find a way to honor it together.

value.name: Lucia fears letter will divide family
value.description: Lucia admits that holding the letter feels like a struggle between her desire for truth and fear that it will tear the family apart.
evidence: every moment I hold this letter feels like a battle between my heart and my fear—what if it tears us apart instead of bringing us closer?

value.name: Rosa counsels trust in family bond
value.description: Rosa reassures Lucia that the truth will guide them through hardship and that their bond and their mother's love can overcome fear.
evidence: Every family faces storms, Lucia, but it's the truth that will guide us to calmer waters; we must trust in our bond and remember that our mother's love is stronger than any fear.

value.name: Lucia fears losing mother's legacy
value.description: Lucia says she is terrified of losing what remains of her mother and worries that mishandling the letter could destroy what her mother built.
evidence: the thought of losing what little we have left of her terrifies me
if we don’t handle this carefully, it could shatter everything she built for us.

value.name: Rosa urges brave confrontation
value.description: Rosa insists they must be brave and face the truth together to safeguard their mother's legacy.
evidence: We must be brave, Lucia; our mother's spirit lives in every corner of this house, and it's time we honor her by facing the truth together, for only then can we truly safeguard her legacy.

value.name: Lucia questions family trust
value.description: Lucia worries that revealing the letter could expose irreparable fractures and asks whether they can truly trust each other.
evidence: I can't shake the feeling that revealing this letter might expose fractures we can't heal; can we really trust each other enough to face whatever it holds?

value.name: Rosa calls for family unity
value.description: Rosa responds that trust is the foundation of their family and asks Lucia to stand united with her no matter what the letter reveals.
evidence: Trust is the cornerstone of our family, Lucia; we have weathered storms before, and together we can navigate this one—let's honor our mother's love by standing united, no matter what this letter reveals.

value.name: Lucia hesitates over unknown contents
value.description: Lucia agrees they must stand united but fears the letter may reveal truths they are not ready to confront.
evidence: I want to stand united, Rosa, but what if this letter brings to light things we weren’t ready to confront?
